provenance.note: A left-handed golfer: 20 tracked 7i shots on hd_golf, 10 declared fade (2026-09-01) and 10 draw (2026-09-02). Face, path and spin axis are golfer-relative, so the shape is read off face-to-path's sign with no flip for the left hand (the plan's finding 5): + is a fade and - a draw beyond 2.0. Which side of the line a shape finishes on is the hand's, so these fades start right and finish left (negative landings) and the draws the reverse, as a left-hander's do. hd_golf prints no landing offline, so every landing is projected: a hand-written flight_landing_offline_yds row (model:flight_v1) on each shot, as the flight writes one when the spin axis resolves (call 6). Edges: 2.1 fade, 2.0 straight, -2.0 straight, -2.1 draw; landings at -9.0 and 9.0 are on line. One fade carried 128, an outlier and so a consistency miss, though not a mishit. hd_golf prints no impact offset and no low point, so both topics are absent. Working. 7i consistency: 20 judged; typical carry 145.0 yd and start-line offline -0.6282623753217573 yd, the medians of the 20 non-mishit judged shots; window 14.5 yd; consistent 19, missed 2026-09-01/7 (carry 128.0, offline 7.814). 7i fade: 10 judged; hit the shape 7, missed it 2026-09-01/5 (2.0: straight), 2026-09-01/6 (1.0: straight), 2026-09-01/9 (-2.5: draw); landings 0 printed and 10 projected; hit and on line 6 of 10, the shape hit and off line 2026-09-01/7 (projected -12.0). 7i draw: 10 judged; hit the shape 8, missed it 2026-09-02/3 (-2.0: straight), 2026-09-02/7 (0.5: straight); landings 0 printed and 10 projected; hit and on line 6 of 10, the shape hit and off line 2026-09-02/4 (projected 11.0), 2026-09-02/8 (projected 14.0). 7i consistency grade 19/20 = 0.95, Wilson [0.7639, 0.9911]. 7i fade grade 6/10 = 0.6, Wilson [0.3127, 0.8318]. 7i fade hit the shape 7/10 = 0.7, Wilson [0.3968, 0.8922]. 7i draw grade 6/10 = 0.6, Wilson [0.3127, 0.8318]. 7i draw hit the shape 8/10 = 0.8, Wilson [0.4902, 0.9433]. 7i blend 0.7166666666666667, averaging ['consistency', 'fade', 'draw'] and excluding []. player consistency: pooled over 7i, 20 judged, grade 19/20 = 0.95, Wilson [0.7639, 0.9911]. player fade: pooled over 7i, 10 judged, grade 6/10 = 0.6, Wilson [0.3127, 0.8318], hit the shape 7/10 = 0.7, Wilson [0.3968, 0.8922]. player draw: pooled over 7i, 10 judged, grade 6/10 = 0.6, Wilson [0.3127, 0.8318], hit the shape 8/10 = 0.8, Wilson [0.4902, 0.9433]. player blend 0.7166666666666667, averaging ['consistency', 'fade', 'draw'] and excluding []. 7i list: scatter on face_to_path_deg at 1.5679; strength on start_line_offline_yds at 0.8855. player list: scatter on face_to_path_deg at 1.5679.
provenance.source: worked by hand in M37 P5, against the M37 plan's decisions 1-8 and calls 2-12 and its P1-P4 findings, before P6-P9 build the code that must meet it. The grades, shares, Wilson intervals (z = 1.959963984540054, each bound clamped to the share and to [0, 1]), the medians, the grid, heel/toe's counts, the blends and the list's kinds, order and ratios are the hand's. Three kinds of number are carried rather than worked, each from the Rust function the plan says P6-P9 read it from, and gated elsewhere: strike.ball_speed and strike.dispersion, and the dispersion each list is ranked from, are analysis::club_profile::build_bag_profile's per club and analysis::dispersion::build_dispersion's over the whole corpus for the player (the career family gates both); heel/toe's mean_offset_mm and its interval are analysis::stats' mean_and_sd and mean_ci over the listed offsets. The corpus is hand-built as crates/storage::read_corpus writes one: each shot a whole ShotData, each launch_monitor row shot_measure's over the analysed view, and each flight or pose row a hand stand-in (detail 'hand'). The rules as worked: a club's topic exists when its every input is printed on one of the club's shots (capability::printed_on), low point only for an iron, wedge or hybrid, and a shape only when one of the club's shots declared it (call 7); its judged shots count toward metrics, are not shot_needs_review, and hold the inputs in the analysed view, and one whose input is printed on it and blank is unscored under its shot_unscored reason, else printed_blank (call 8); the player pools each topic over the clubs it exists for, and over the untagged shots for strike location and the shapes (call 9); a blend is the left-to-right sum of its graded shares in topic order over their count (call 11). The list (call 12) reads each club's ClubProfile.dispersion, and for the player the whole corpus' kept to club-independent metrics, over launch_monitor rows only: a weakness is an established bias, ratio |offset| / tolerance, or scatter, ratio sd / tolerance, largest first, ties in METRIC_TARGETS order and bias before scatter; a strength is a metric with a target whose center_ci lies inside target +/- tolerance (inclusive) and whose sd_ci.high is below the tolerance (strict), ratio max(|center_ci end - target|, sd_ci.high) / tolerance, smallest first, after every weakness
